summary: Frontend-only regression completed for the Fox foundation shell. Desktop and mobile load, theme toggle, mock content, FAB modal, navigation, placeholders, unknown-route error state, and responsive overflow checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical implementation issues found in the reviewed foundation files. Financial data is isolated in frontend mocks as requested.
The initial automated attempt used English navigation test IDs; the implementation intentionally generates IDs from Portuguese labels (for example nav-pessoas). This was corrected in the test only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested: https://fox-ui-core.preview.emergentagent.com/. Focused Playwright run passed on desktop and 390px mobile. No API, auth, persistence, or external integration was exercised because Prompt 01 requires mocks only.
rca of the issue: The only failed attempt was caused by the test selecting nav-people while the UI exposes nav-pessoas from its Portuguese label. Re-running with the actual data-testid passed all navigation checks.
